meta.prompt: Show what is playing right now as an inline music card, playing at 1:14 into the track: Midnight City by M83, 4:03 long, with drawn album art, a progress bar with the elapsed time and the time remaining, previous, play or pause and next buttons, and a like button that reads "Like" and, once pressed, "Liked". Under it the next three tracks in the queue: Golden Hour, JVKE, 3:29; Ocean Eyes, Billie Eilish, 3:20; Electric Feel, MGMT, 3:49 (after those comes Dreams, Fleetwood Mac, 4:17). Next moves on to the following track from 0:00 and the queue moves up with it.
meta.text:
state elapsed=74
state playing=true
state liked=false
state idx=0
state tracks=[{"title":"Midnight City","artist":"M83","len":243,"tone":"dusk"},{"title":"Golden Hour","artist":"JVKE","len":209,"tone":"sand"},{"title":"Ocean Eyes","artist":"Billie Eilish","len":200,"tone":"sky"},{"title":"Electric Feel","artist":"MGMT","len":229,"tone":"mint"},{"title":"Dreams","artist":"Fleetwood Mac","len":257,"tone":"rose"}]
every 1000 when playing -> elapsed=min(elapsed+1,tracks[idx].len)
Card w:390 gap:12
  Row gap:12
    Media kind:"train" tone:"dusk" w:64 h:64 radius:8
    Column gap:2 grow
      Text.heading "{tracks[idx].title}"
      Text.bodySecondary "{tracks[idx].artist}"
  Progress =elapsed
  Row between
    Text.caption "{formatTime(elapsed)}"
    Text.caption "-{formatTime(tracks[idx].len-elapsed)}"
  Row center gap:20
    IconButton "skip_previous" -> elapsed=0
    IconButton "{playing?'pause':'play_arrow'}" -> playing=!playing
    IconButton "skip_next" -> idx=min(idx+1,4); elapsed=0
  Button.outline "{liked?'Liked':'Like'}" -> liked=!liked
  Text.caption "Up next"
  ListView gap:8
    each t in tracks
      if t.title!=tracks[idx].title
        Row gap:10
          Media kind:"train" tone:t.tone w:40 h:40 radius:6
          Column grow
            Text.body "{t.title}"
            Text.bodySecondary "{t.artist}"
          Text.caption "{formatTime(t.len)}"
